info.name: GailGas Employee Mobile APIs
info.description: Complete implemented employee-mobile-routes workflow: six POST actions, all four supported report combinations, and PDF GET (10 requests). Set baseUrl, employeeEmail, employeePassword, mfaCode and bpNumber; run Login first. Uses native Web Crypto in current Postman, with automatic WCF AES-256-CBC/HMAC encryption and response verification. Edit readable JSON bodies normally; scripts encrypt on send. See Visualize for decrypted responses. Login/session variables are saved automatically. Static key must match server EMPLOYEE_REQUEST_ENCRYPTION_KEY. Complaints use static encryption, not the session key. GET action dispatcher is declared but has no implemented GET actions. Set request timeout to 0 for long-running reports. See src/docs/employee-mobile-postman.md.

request.description: Active AD employee account required (IsADUsers = 1). Supply password in plaintext here; the script encrypts the complete payload. MFA enrollment and a fresh authenticator code are required. Saves Token, Key and ProflieInfo.UserId. A new login invalidates previous employee tokens.
Requires login and a valid BP number. Uses the session encryption key and Token header.

Optional exact-match filters; leave blank for all pending complaints. Limit 1–200. Stores the first returned ComplaintRegisterId for subsequent requests. Uses the static key; this handler does not validate an employee token.
Existing nonzero ComplaintRegisterId required. Uses the static employee key.
Limit 1–500. An empty history is a valid response. Uses the static employee key.
Requires login. Generates a PDF and stores its PDFUrl in reportUrl. Stored procedures can take more than five minutes; set Postman request timeout to 0.

return JSON.parse(new TextDecoder().decode(await crypto.subtle.decrypt({ name: 'AES-CBC', iv: this.bytes(iv) }, aes, this.bytes(cipher))));
